notes: Lyoplate B-cell panel from a multi-site standardization study. The parent of Step 1 is already pre-gated 'Live singlet lymphocytes' — Steps that would normally perform scatter-based lymphocyte gating, singlet discrimination, and viability-based dead-cell exclusion have been applied upstream (via the original Lyoplate gating hierarchy) and are omitted from this plan. `x_marker` / `y_marker` fields use protein marker names directly (no fluorophore channel translation needed, because the parquet column names are already marker-based — see `parquet/meta.json`).

steps.note: Lymphocyte lineage split on pre-gated Live singlet lymphocytes. CD19pos: CD19+ CD3- (B-lineage; entry point for all downstream B-cell subsetting). CD3pos: CD3+ CD19- (T-lineage; terminates here in this panel — no further T-cell resolution, since this cohort has separate T-cell / Treg panels). CD3- CD19- events (NK cells, residual non-B/T lineages) are not annotated at this step because the remainder is not a defined cell type for this panel's purpose.

Split mature B-cell pool from CD20-negative B-lineage (pre-plasmablast) within CD19+ cells. CD19_CD20pos: CD20+ (mature B cells; the dominant CD19+ population in blood, includes naive/memory/transitional resolved at Steps 3–4). CD19_CD20neg: CD20- (plasmablast candidates; mature plasmablasts down-regulate CD20 as they differentiate — resolved at Step 5). Axis design caveat: x_marker is CD3, but parent is CD19+ CD3- — CD3 on x is a purity sanity-check axis (events should cluster at CD3-low); the actual split is driven by CD20 on y.

Mature B-cell maturation / class-switch state (IgD × CD27 quadrants, widely used Klein/Sanz scheme). Naive: IgD+ CD27- (un-activated naive B cells; surface IgM+ IgD+, no somatic hypermutation, no class switch). Memory_IgDpos: IgD+ CD27+ (non-switched memory / IgM memory B cells; may include marginal-zone-like B cells, although the IgM-memory vs MZ-like boundary is not strictly resolved by IgD/CD27 alone). Memory_IgDneg: IgD- CD27+ (class-switched memory B cells — the major CD27+ memory population carrying IgG/IgA/IgE). IgDneg_CD27neg: IgD- CD27- (double-negative / DN B cells). The DN compartment is heterogeneous and may include subsets such as 'age-associated B cells' (ABCs, classically T-bet+ CD11c+ — neither marker is in this panel), activated-naive-like, or exhausted B cells; the DN compartment as a whole has been reported to expand in autoimmunity and chronic infection, but further sub-classification within DN is not possible from this panel alone. Useful co-markers: CD38 further separates transitional B cells (CD38hi CD24hi, resolved in parallel at Step 4), which sit inside the Naive quadrant here.

Transitional B-cell identification (independent of the IgD/CD27 axis used at Step 3 — parallel annotation on the same parent). Transitional: CD38hi CD24hi (recent bone-marrow emigrants, immature B cells that retain IgM+IgD+ surface expression). Overlap caveat: transitional B cells are IgD+ CD27-, so they also fall into the `Naive` bin at Step 3 — Step 3 and Step 4 produce overlapping labels on the same cells by design, not as an artifact (downstream analyses that need a Naive-without-Transitional pool should compute `Naive AND NOT Transitional` via boolean operation). Useful co-markers: IgM is typically high on transitional B but is not in this panel.

Plasmablast identification within the CD19+ CD20- pool. Plasmablasts: CD38++ CD27+ (antibody-secreting B-lineage cells; rare population, typically <5% of CD19+ B cells at baseline but expands rapidly during acute immune responses). Parent design is important: plasmablasts are CD20-low/negative, so they would be missed if gated from the CD20+ (mature B) branch — hence the separate parent at Step 2. The CD19+ CD20- parent also contains CD19+CD20- non-plasmablast residuals, which are excluded by requiring CD27+ CD38++ here.
